text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No specific information is available on the treatment of overdosage with tigecycline. Intravenous administration of tigecycline for injection at a single dose of 300 mg over 60 minutes in healthy volunteers resulted in an increased incidence of nausea and vomiting. Tigecycline is not removed in significant quantities by hemodialysis.
